decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategies through a combination of countermagic and disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe. The deck also aims to control the game through cards like Standstill and Force of Will, while utilizing powerful cards like Tarmogoyf and Lurrus of the Dream-Den for additional threats. The deck is built around maintaining control of the board with efficient removal and disruption, while also having the ability to generate card advantage and close out the game quickly with powerful creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard synergies and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. It aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Bazaar of Baghdad to enable powerful creatures like Hogaak, Vengevine, and Hollow One. The inclusion of Force of Vigor and Collector Ouphe helps deal with opponent's threats while maintaining its aggressive pace. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Mental Misstep to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while providing necessary disruption through cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Bloodghast to enable powerful graveyard synergies with cards like Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. Using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time to dig for pieces, the deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays. Additionally, using disruptive cards like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor, it aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while executing its own game plan efficiently. The deck utilizes the unique effects of Bazaar of Baghdad to help dig for key pieces and set up explosive turns.

The main strategy of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Combo - Dredge deck is to utilize cards that allow for self-mill, such as Golgari Thug and Stinkweed Imp, in order to fill the graveyard with creatures like Ichorid and Narcomoeba. By doing so, the deck is able to consistently bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Hollow One from the graveyard, quickly overwhelming the opponent with a strong board presence. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its gameplan while also running efficient removal options like Force of Vigor.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game using powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils, Oko, Thief of Crowns, and Wrenn and Six, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Collector Ouphe and Deathrite Shaman. The deck also includes a suite of powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect your key threats. The mana base is designed to provide a mixture of colors for casting spells efficiently, while also including disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a board state of aggressive artifacts that can overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Phyrexian Revoker and Nettlecyst. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge provide additional value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to establish a fast and powerful board presence to win the game before the opponent can mount a defense.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful disruptive and card advantage spells along with efficient creatures to control the board and pressure the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while generating card advantage through spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional card advantage and recursion. The deck also utilizes mana denial strategies with Wasteland and Strip Mine to prevent the opponent from developing their board. Overall, the deck is designed to be proactive and efficient in its game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively utilize discard outlets like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to quickly get powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One onto the battlefield. The deck also contains a suite of powerful free counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its threats. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Master of Death and Squee, Goblin Nabob to help maintain card advantage and resilience. Its overall strategy is to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures backed up by disruption and card advantage.

The key strategy of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counter spells and removal, while also utilizing powerful card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Sphinx of the Steel Wind. By efficiently disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Flusterstorm and Force of Will, and searching for key pieces with Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor, the deck aims to out value and outlast the opponent. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel, along with mana acceleration from the Moxen and Tolarian Academy, help to generate consistent advantage and finish the game decisively.

This deck focuses on utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures like Bloodghast, Hogaak, and Vengevine. By casting powerful creatures like Hollow One and using cards like Once Upon a Time to maintain pressure on the opponent, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. With the ability to bring back creatures from the graveyard and destroy opponent's artifacts and enchantments with Force of Vigor, this deck can quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, along with disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Thorn of Amethyst to control the board and quickly overwhelm the opponent. With mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and Moxen, as well as lands like Mishra's Workshop and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to establish an early board presence and lock down the opponent's resources. The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana and drawing through the deck quickly using cards like Paradoxical Outcome, to set up a game-winning combo. It includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Tinker to search for key pieces like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. The key strategy is to efficiently assemble the combo pieces and win the game quickly before the opponent can respond effectively.

This combo deck focuses on leveraging the powerful card Underworld Breach to create infinite loops and graveyard recursion, allowing the player to cast multiple spells in a single turn and overwhelm the opponent quickly. By filling the graveyard with key spells and using cards like Tinker and Demonic Tutor to find essential pieces, the deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn. The deck includes various card draw, counterspells, and tutors to help assemble the combo pieces and protect the player's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful card [[Underworld Breach]] in combination with various efficient spells and fast mana to quickly assemble a winning combo. The deck includes a variety of card draw, countermagic, and tutors to find key combo pieces like [[Bolas's Citadel]] and [[Brain Freeze]]. By effectively managing resources and utilizing the graveyard as a resource, the deck aims to create a fast and resilient win condition that can overwhelm opponents in the early turns of the game.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 combo deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with Dredge creatures like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to facilitate this. The goal is to power out powerful creatures like Hollow One and Prized Amalgam while utilizing creatures like Narcomoeba and Ichorid to continually recur threats from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo, making it a strong and resilient strategy in the format.

The main objective of this Esper Control deck is to control the game through various counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan using cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Pithing Needle, while also generating card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Ancestral Recall. Additionally, the deck has the potential to combo off with cards like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel, providing alternate win conditions. The mana base is optimized for fast and efficient mana production to support the deck's control elements.
